intent: A first-run checklist with overall progress, each task's status in words (Done, Skipped) and one action per task. Built on kit Progress, Badge, Button and Empty. Not a wizard stepper and not a bare Progress bar.
useWhen: onboard a new workspace with a short list of setup tasks
show how far setup is and what to do next
let people skip optional tasks and undo the skip
doNotUseWhen: one value against a goal — Progress
an agent's plan of steps — AgentPlan

onTaskAction.note: (id) => void. Continue on the current task (outline), Start on todo tasks (ghost).

onComplete.note: Go to dashboard, the one solid primary once every task is done or skipped.

requirements: tasks are an ordered list; the current task has aria-current=step
done and skipped are words next to the icon, not colour alone
each action button is described by its task label
overall progress is a kit Progress with a text label ("2 of 5 done")
the check scales and fades in (transform and opacity), off under prefers-reduced-motion
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local Checklist, OnboardingCard or SetupSteps
Do not use ProgressSteps for a checklist people can do in any order
Do not show more than one solid primary; Continue stays outline
snippet: <SetupGuide title="Get Northwind ready" tasks={tasks} onTaskAction={openTask} onUndoSkip={undoSkip} onComplete={goToDashboard} onDismiss={dismiss} />
